source_review.notes: Checked twelve current primary documentation sources from Apache Spark, Apache Flink, Apache Hadoop, and Dask. All URLs returned HTTP 200. Sources support merge hints, range repartition and within-partition sorting, adaptive skew handling, shuffle-sort merging, external-merge fan-in and spill controls, equal-group cross products, and sorted-layout reuse.

evidence: Reviewed partition multisets L_j/R_j, comparator preceq, bytes B, usable memory M, runs r, fan-in F, rounds q, equal groups A_x/B_x, and multiplicities m_x/n_x.
Checked join equality, comparator equivalence, partition co-location, local ordering, run order, and stable tie order remain distinct.
Checked snapshot, partition epoch, comparator identity, side, producer/sort/join attempt, run, group spool, and sink commit identities are consistent.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Relational semantics, distribution, ordering, external-sort accounting, and physical artifacts are not conflated.

evidence: Executed sort-merge-join-accounting with Python 3.14.4 and reproduced five inner rows and nine full-outer rows.
Recomputed 960/120 as eight ideal runs, ceil(log base 4 of 8) as two rounds, and 2*960*(1+2) as 5,760 MiB.
Recomputed four-task admission as 4*(256+96+64)=1,664 MiB and key multiplicity 2,000*30,000=60,000,000 pairs.
Recomputed exercises as 20 runs, two rounds, 21.6 TiB scoped I/O; two 24,000,000-byte groups; and 9.6 billion pairs.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The fixture validates group advancement, multiplicity, null/outer behavior, and arithmetic only; it is not an external-sort, collation, network, or performance benchmark.

evidence: Verified ideal r=ceil(B/M), q=ceil(log_F r), and scoped full-materialization accounting 2B(1+q) under stated assumptions.
Verified when a<b in compatible sorted streams, every unread right key is at least b and cannot match a.
Verified equal groups contribute m_x*n_x inner pairs and local partition unions preserve the global multiset join.
Checked comparator compatibility, complete co-location, run multiset conservation, and one accepted attempt are necessary premises.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Run and I/O equations are idealized accounting, not worst-case byte, latency, or throughput guarantees.

evidence: Reviewed empty/one-sided inputs, one/all-equal/duplicate keys, null/null-safe keys, NaNs, signed zero, composite keys, coercion, collation, residual predicates, and inner/outer/semi/anti joins.
Reviewed giant rows/groups, overlapping sorted files, skew, one/many runs, fan-in boundaries, descriptor exhaustion, disk full, and output explosion.
Reviewed short/corrupt/truncated/reordered runs, remote throttling, worker loss, cancellation, retry, speculation, adaptive splitting, mixed comparators/epochs, and sink backpressure.
Reviewed sensitive key leakage, unauthorized regions/tenants, credential/key rotation, retention, legal holds, and deletion races.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Comparator correctness, order, multiset conservation, join semantics, resource safety, attempt fencing, and governance can fail independently.

evidence: Traced rows through compatible partitioning, bounded sort arena, immutable runs, k-way merge, equal-group processing, attempt-scoped output, and one committed sink winner.
Checked every run is ordered and merge output is the exact sorted multiset union of inputs.
Checked unequal advancement cannot skip matches and equal groups retain duplicate and residual-predicate semantics.
Checked memory, fan-in, descriptors, disk, spool/replay, output, concurrent tasks, retries, and cleanup are charged and bounded.
invariant_checking.notes: Complete accepted manifests and comparator identity, not filenames or claimed order, authorize merge consumption.

evidence: Reviewed the ten-step audit from semantics and co-location through comparator proof, run generation, admission, merge, group processing, attempt commit, measurement, and deletion.
Checked inner soundness/completeness and multiset multiplicity from ordered advancement and exact equal-group products.
Checked outer/semi/anti extensions require complete opposite evidence, residual evaluation, and unique unmatched ownership.
Reviewed counterexamples for repartition-implies-sort, ascending-implies-compatible, comparator-zero-implies-equality, constant-memory merge, concatenated runs, and retry-generation mixing.
proof_review.notes: Proof claims are conditional on complete compatible inputs; capacity and performance require measured runtime evidence.

evidence: Audited uses of sorted, compatible, total, complete, exact, immutable, accepted, stable, reusable, idealized, upper accounting, bounded, and safe.
Confirmed I/O scope and fusion exclusions are explicit and average/run formulas are not presented as universal bounds.
Confirmed engine-specific hint, spill, merge, and sorted-layout behavior is sourced rather than generalized silently.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Correctness theorems, implementation observations, and planning heuristics are labeled separately.

evidence: Reviewed proposed measurements for input/run bytes, runs/rounds/fan-in, compare CPU, spill, descriptors, disk/network I/O, group sizes, pairs, spool, backpressure, retries, and cleanup.
Confirmed no universal memory size, fan-in, spill threshold, fusion choice, group block, skew split, comparator, tie-break, or retention is prescribed.
Checked estimated versus actual, source versus spill versus output bytes, mean versus maximum, and accepted versus failed/losing attempts remain separate.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Production choices require representative schemas, comparators, key/group/output distributions, storage, topology, concurrency, failure, threat, and policy evidence.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed distributed sort-merge join as compatible partitioning plus external sorting plus relational merge, spanning comparator contracts, runs/fan-in/I/O, fusion, duplicate groups, all join semantics, order reuse, skew, retries, security, and lifecycle.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed practical sort arenas, large-row paths, immutable runs, k-way merge, descriptor/disk admission, group spool/replay, source-order audits, skew splitting, fused recovery, observability, fault injection, and governed cleanup. Internal practitioner-oriented review only.

pedagogical_review.notes: Verified progression from semantics and comparator compatibility through external sorting, merge proofs, group bounds, alternatives, failures, and governance. Ten examples and five complete exercises cover run math, collation, multiplicity, overlapping runs, residual outer semantics, nulls, concurrency, corruption, proofs, and full-outer testing.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external Spark, Flink, Hadoop, or Dask maintainer, database/query-optimization or algorithms researcher, comparator/collation specialist, runtime/storage/network/performance specialist, security/privacy/legal/records authority, affected-tenant reviewer, accessibility specialist, or certification review is claimed.
